verdict.rationale: LocalAI documents native tool calling: it serves the OpenAI functions/tools API across multiple backends, and an autoparser detects the tool-call format of GGUF models trained with tool support, with no configuration needed. Nothing in the evidence covers reasoning-parser support, such as separating thinking or reasoning content in responses, so only about half the story is evidenced. Missing for 10: any documentation of reasoning-parser support, and independent or hands-on corroboration of tool-call parsing.

support.subject: As a developer, I can use native tool-calling and reasoning-parser support in my requests

citations.quote: LocalAI supports running the OpenAI functions and tools API across multiple backends.
No configuration required - the autoparser detects the tool call format for any ggml/gguf model that was trained with tool support.
